issues.description: Method parameter type mismatch for PersonService.deletePerson: The problem statement (DELETE /persons/{personId}) and the template implementation expect a service method public void deletePerson(UUID personId) that deletes a person by its UUID. In the solution repository PersonResource.deletePerson(@PathVariable UUID personId) calls personService.deletePerson(personId), but the solution's PersonService declares public void deletePerson(Person person). This mismatch (service expects a Person, caller passes a UUID) will cause a compile-time error and contradicts the REST API contract described in the assignment, confusing students and preventing a correct implementation.
issues.suggestedFix: Restore a consistent service signature that matches the REST endpoint contract. Change the solution's PersonService.deletePerson(Person person) to public void deletePerson(UUID personId) and implement deletion by id (e.g., persons.removeIf(p -> p.getId().equals(personId))). Alternatively, if the design intends passing a Person, update PersonResource to obtain the Person instance before calling the service — but the preferred fix is to revert to deletePerson(UUID) so the service matches the DELETE /persons/{personId} endpoint and the template/problem specification.
